title: Publish zero-target execution decisions after successful diagnosis
description:
As an optimization operator, I need a bounded portfolio run with no safe optimizer target to publish its execution decision and finalize cleanly, so that a valid no-target outcome is not reported as a platform failure.

Feature: Zero-target execution decision publication

Scenario: Diagnosis finds no safe optimization target
  Given exhaustive ranking and assessment are complete
  And every bounded semantic diagnosis resolves to a repair or non-executable disposition
  When automatic execution policy selects zero targets
  Then the approval or execution-decision core milestone publishes successfully
  And the same Report states that no safe target was selected
  And no optimizer child Procedure or Task is created
  And final detail reconciliation may proceed normally

Scenario: Core decision publication fails
  Given diagnosis evidence is already durably published
  When the next authoritative decision milestone cannot publish
  Then the run fails closed with the underlying failure class visible in sanitized diagnostics
  And no optimizer child is launched

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Production dogfood reproduced the sanitized scenario after complete ranking, assessment, and bounded diagnosis. The diagnosis core revision was durable, the automatic policy selected no executable target, and the subsequent decision milestone failed before any child launch. Investigation is focused on preserving the exact underlying publication error and making zero-target publication deterministic.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Investigation result: the frozen zero-target decision packet rebuilds its stakeholder projection, workbook, and aggregate presentation deterministically, so the observed production failure occurred before any next-revision artifact upload. Added operation-level sanitized failure classification, a fail-closed status-block overlay, and regression coverage. Browser acceptance also exposed that a stale next action could classify a canonical not-selected score as automatic work; canonical disposition now wins. Focused validation: 255 backend tests, 34 dashboard report tests, dashboard typecheck, 776 dashboard coverage tests, 91 Storybook suites / 704 Chromium tests, and the complete Python 3.12 suite with 4519 passing. Python 3.11 full validation is running. No optimizer child, score mutation, or champion promotion occurred.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Validation completed for the fail-closed zero-target reporting repair. Canonical non-selected dispositions no longer inherit stale execution actions; completed zero-target policy emits the no-safe-target conclusion; and publication failures overlay the latest durable presentation with sanitized operation and exception class. Python 3.11 and 3.12 full suites are green with 4519 passing tests each, alongside focused backend and dashboard coverage. The original publication authority failure is not claimed fixed until a future explicitly approved pilot confirms the newly classified operation; no additional production run was started.
